'''Marsha Hicks''' is a ship Engineer based at '''The Watchtower''' in the '''Tir''' system of the [[Colonia]] region. A former criminal who left the Bubble after the death of her daughter, she now works on projectile weapons, limpet controllers, Fuel Scoops, and Refineries.<ref name="edwiki-marsha">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Marsha_Hicks Marsha Hicks], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Marsha provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for every module family in her workshop.<ref name="inara-marsha">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/21/ Marsha Hicks — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Tir
* '''Body:''' Tir A 2
* '''Facility:''' The Watchtower
* '''Region:''' [[Colonia]]
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship modules, projectile weapons, limpets, and mining support
* '''Referral required:''' [[The Dweller]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

The workshop's distance from the Bubble does not change its access conditions; a Commander must travel to Tir to provide the unlock commodity and use Marsha's services.

== Access requirements ==

Access to Marsha Hicks has three direct requirements:<ref name="inara-marsha" /><ref name="edwiki-marsha" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access''' and progress at least one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with [[The Dweller]] to receive his referral.
# Reach the Pilots Federation '''Exploration rank of Surveyor''' or higher.
# Deliver '''10 units of mined Osmium''' to The Watchtower.

The referral reveals Marsha, but it does not satisfy the Exploration-rank or Osmium requirements. Osmium is a cargo commodity rather than an Engineering material, so the full contribution requires at least 10 tonnes of free cargo capacity. The detailed acquisition method belongs to [[Mining]].

For route preparation, obtaining qualifying Osmium, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Marsha Hicks]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Marsha Hicks increases by crafting modifications at her workshop.<ref name="inara-marsha" /> Current Engineer records do not list commodity sales, exploration data, or bounty vouchers as an alternative reputation method.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Marsha supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-marsha" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications for the three weapon families belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add four Grade 5 Operations-era services to Marsha's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-marsha" />

* '''Force Impact''' for Cannons
* '''Double Screaming''' for Fragment Cannons
* '''Rapid Phase''' for Multi-Cannons
* '''Scoop Rate Enhanced''' for Fuel Scoops

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Their exact modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Marsha Hicks blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade she offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Referral branch ==

Marsha Hicks is currently the end of this Engineer referral branch; no outgoing Engineer referral is listed for her.<ref name="inara-engineers">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref> The other Colonia Engineers are reached through separate referral branches.

For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
